title: Corpus Forge Workbench

hero.headline: The chatbot is not the product.
hero.support: The product is the durable, governed transformation of a corpus: sources, claims, contradictions, citations, decisions, revisions, and artifacts that remain connected after the conversation ends.

sections.heading: From chat to governed work
sections.body: Conversation becomes an interface into a durable research system rather than a transient container for decisions.

sections.heading: Preserve provenance
sections.body: Sources, extracted claims, counterevidence, maturity, ownership, review, and supersession remain inspectable.

sections.heading: Keep contradictions alive
sections.body: Disagreement is recorded and adjudicated instead of silently averaged away.

sections.heading: Promote deliberately
sections.body: Notes become claims, claims become artifacts, and artifacts become public only through explicit review gates.

sections.heading: Research operations as product
sections.body: The workbench connects chat, source material, documents, claim ledgers, citations, replacement history, and structured corpus transformations.
